behavior: A PR closing an issue tracked by an active spec fails the gate, names the spec, and prints the dotf spec archive command. Covers a spec created in the same PR, and multiple closing references.
The same PR passes once specs/archive/<id>/ exists at the head ref.
Non-closing references (Refs #N, Part of #N, a bare #N in prose) do not trigger the check.
All three issue: frontmatter shapes in-tree are matched (owner/repo#N, repo#N, bare N), plus the full-URL closing form, case-insensitively.
A closing reference qualified with another repository is ignored.
The check runs below the LOC threshold and is not skipped by the skip-sdd label.
skip-archive plus a non-empty '## Archive skip rationale' passes; the label without the rationale fails.
An empty PR body, a closed issue with no matching active spec, a spec without issue frontmatter, and an already-archived spec are all clean passes.
The pre-existing LOC half of the Discipline Gate is unchanged.
